extract: Hyukoh is a South Korean indie band signed to DooRooDooRoo Artist Company. The band was formed in May 2014 and consists of leader, singer, and guitarist Oh Hyuk, bassist Im Dong-geon, guitarist Lim Hyun-jae, and drummer Lee In-woo. Later joined by producer and electronics musician JNKYRD in 2020, who performs as a core part of the group despite not being part of the official lineup.
